title: Fit Shape to Text (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Fit Shape to Text applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Fit Shape to Text (BtnFitFormToText) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Fit Form to Text grows an undersized box to its text in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Fit Form to Text on a 100x20 pt text box holding a long wrapping sample (AutoSize off) grows the shape height in the documented direction (grow-to-text; height after is greater than height before), reports execution, keeps the shape count unchanged, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.
